backlog.title: Bugfix Wave 1 — Post-Validation Fixes (BUG-001..BUG-008)
backlog.description: Fix the 8 verified bugs from the post-validation adversarial bug hunt against the shipped M8 delta (WRITEIN/AUTOSUBMIT/SURFACE): 3 majors (gate-hold dead code, R4 draft loss on ctrl+c/discuss/note-mode, AC-13 '(changed)' unreachable) and 5 minors (duty persistence across navigation, write-in invisibility, unbounded multi-line delta, swallowed bridge errors, enter no-op on text questions). milestones.title: Major correctness fixes (BUG-001, BUG-002, BUG-003)
milestones.description: Restore the three broken hard promises: FR-3/AC-2d gate-hold feedback, R4/ESC-002 draft sacredness on every editor exit, and AC-13/FR-2 '(changed)' marker through the real submit pipeline.

tasks.title: Restore gate-hold ⚠ line in canonical flows (BUG-001)
tasks.description: maybeAutoSubmit's completeness early-return fires before gate-hold arming, so the canonical 'answering later groups while a foundational question is open' scenario renders no ⚠ line and hides the ctrl+s override. Reorder so the hold arms whenever unanswered gate questions exist at commit time.

subtasks.title: Reorder maybeAutoSubmit: arm gate-hold before the completeness return
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: architecture/bug-001-gate-hold.md (verified @ 613437d). maybeAutoSubmit at src/panel/actions.ts:604-641: `if (unanswered > 0) return;` at :611 precedes hold arming at :624-635. Helpers: countUnansweredGate (src/panel/gate.ts:100), gateHoldLine (gate.ts:143), gateGroupNames (gate.ts:68). panel.gateWarning declared src/panel/panel.ts:479-481, rendered non-expiring by footerNoticeLine (panel.ts:1204-1220), any-key dismiss (panel.ts:778-781).

3. LOGIC: Implement FR-3/AC-2d (PRD h3.0): move the gate-hold computation BEFORE the completeness return — on every commit, compute n = countUnansweredGate(state); when n > 0 AND there are pending/unanswered non-gate answers, arm panel.gateWarning = gateHoldLine(...) and return WITHOUT auto-submitting (this now also fires when the gate question itself is open/reasked — the canonical scenario). Preserve: zero-pending silence (n > 0 but nothing new committed → no line), auto-submit when complete with n === 0, and the existing closed-no-answer hold path. TDD: invert the pinned deviation test src/panel/actions.test.ts:2042 (test_auto_open_gate_question_returns_at_completeness_no_hold_line → now asserts the ⚠ line arms and no auto-submit in the canonical g1-open + n1/n2-answered scenario); adjust the HOLD_FIXTURE describe (actions.test.ts:1937-2058) as needed; test at :2023 (non-gate silence) must stay green. Panel harness: makePanel/seed/makeDeps stubs (actions.test.ts:29-112) — no mocking beyond the standard TUI stub.
4. OUTPUT: maybeAutoSubmit that arms gateWarning in the canonical scenario; all commit paths (actions.ts:251,311; ripple-confirm.ts:160,304; remote-submit.ts:165,181; index.ts:107-109) inherit the behavior unchanged. Consumed by P1.M1.T1.S2.

tasks.title: Make AC-13 '(changed)' marker reachable through the real submit pipeline (BUG-003)
tasks.description: editedArchived requires a 'closed' baseline status, but snapshots are only taken post-markSubmitted and the agent-settled close pass never snapshots — so '(changed)' can never fire in production. Take a snapshot at the close pass after auditing ring consumers.

tasks.description: textDuty survives question navigation, so enter commits a write-in on a question whose cursor sits on a real option, violating WRITEIN-001 FR-12's cursor-follow rule. Re-derive duty from the new question's cursor position in syncBufferToQuestion.

subtasks.title: Re-derive textDuty in syncBufferToQuestion from the new question's cursor position
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: architecture/bug-004-textduty.md — textDuty declared src/panel/panel.ts:427, reset ONLY in blurTextField (panel.ts:1086). Navigation: prev/next config keys are ungated in editor focus (keys.ts step 4) → prev/nextQuestion → currentId setter (panel.ts:352-363) reseeds cursorIndex = initialCursorIndex(q) (★ preselect) BEFORE calling syncBufferToQuestion (panel.ts:985-1019), which writes the draft through but never re-derives duty; the enter fork (panel.ts:794-803) then trusts the stale duty. desiredTextDuty predicate lives at src/panel/keys.ts:288 (→ 'writein' for type:'text'; cursor-position rules otherwise). Duty labels: renderDutyLabel layout.ts:277-290 ('OTHER — this text is the answer' / 'EXPLAIN — …').
2. INPUT: Frozen panel.ts draft machinery from P1.M1.T2.S3; the desiredTextDuty predicate logic (keys.ts:288) to extract.
3. LOGIC: Implement PRD h3.3 / recommendation 4: at the END of syncBufferToQuestion, when focus === 'text', re-derive panel.textDuty from the NEW question's type + the already-reseeded cursorIndex, using a pure predicate EXTRACTED from desiredTextDuty into a shared module (a direct keys.ts→panel.ts import risks a cycle — verify with the existing module graph; keys.ts imports panel types). Navigation to a choice question with cursor on a real option → duty 'elaboration' (enter saves+blurs, never answers); to a type:'text' question → duty 'writein' (enter commits); back to a question with cursor on the ✎/Other row → duty 'writein'. TDD: repro test first — writein duty on q1 Other row → handleInput('\x1b[Z') (shift+tab) to q2 (cursor on ★ real option) → type + enter → q2 NOT answered as {value, custom:true} (it is a save+blur); then the text-question and navigate-back cases. Panel harness; no external mocks.
4. OUTPUT: Duty follows cursor position after every navigation; the 'OTHER — this text is the answer' label updates on swap (via existing renderDutyLabel wiring).
5. DOCS: Mode A — update JSDoc on syncBufferToQuestion documenting the duty re-derivation rule (cursor-follow per FR-12).

tasks.title: Bridge submit internal-error nack (BUG-007)
tasks.description: The pi-ask submit handler's bare catch swallows unexpected internal errors after state mutation, so remote clients hang without an ack while state sits half-mutated. Emit a submit-result nack and complete the flow instead.

subtasks.title: Emit submit-result nack + completeFlow on unexpected internal errors in the bridge submit handler
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: architecture/bug-007-bridge-errors.md — outer bare `catch {}` at src/remote-bridge.ts:261-267 (bus guard; its docstring's 'state consistency is guarded upstream' claim is false today). Submit path: requestId + flowId parsed at remote-bridge.ts:303-304; recordRemoteSubmission invoked ~:348; emitSubmitResult at :287-298 with error union at :289 limited to 'flow_not_found' | 'invalid_answer'; completeFlow for flow teardown. recordRemoteSubmission (src/remote-submit.ts) mutates state first: applyAnswer :130 → markSubmitted :155 → deliverSubmission :173 → noteSubmissionDelivered :176 → maybeAutoSubmit :181 — NO rollback is possible (snapshot ring/epoch are not undoable; do NOT attempt rollback).
2. INPUT: Unmodified bridge submit handler; the emitSubmitResult helper to reuse.
3. LOGIC: Implement PRD h3.6 / recommendation 6: wrap the recordRemoteSubmission call (~remote-bridge.ts:348) in try/catch — on ANY unexpected internal error, emit a submit-result nack via emitSubmitResult with a widened error literal (add 'internal_error' to the union at :289) and call completeFlow(flowId) so the remote client receives its ack and never hangs; keep the outer bare catch strictly as a last-resort bus guard. TDD: use the FakeBus + makePi + makeBridge harness (src/remote-bridge.test.ts:21-75), inject a throwing state via RemoteBridgeOptions.getState (e.g. a state whose applyAnswer path throws from a listener) → assert the submit-result event is emitted on the fake bus with ok:false + error 'internal_error' AND the flow is completed; also assert valid submits and validation nacks are unchanged. Mock: FakeBus events bus + fake pi only — never a real pi or events bus.
4. OUTPUT: Remote clients always receive a submit-result (ok or nack); state remains half-mutated only in the documented worst case (no rollback, next upsert resurfaces).
5. DOCS: Mode A — if spec/tool-protocol.md documents the submit-result error values, add 'internal_error' there (spec/ is living documentation); README has no bridge-ack passage (verified), so no README change.
